implementation: Compact fixed-use/destination descriptors plus dynamic shapes for calls, returns and indexed memory operations; compiler-only prototype, reverted.
patch:
diff --git a/core/compiler/ir.jo b/core/compiler/ir.jo
index 53de4841..a6a0dd69 100644
--- a/core/compiler/ir.jo
+++ b/core/compiler/ir.jo
@@ -328,10 +328,29 @@ ir_has_use = (v: int) -> bool:
         if ir_use(i) == v: return true
     false
 
+# Fixed operand shapes encode use count in bits 0..1 and a destination in
+# bit 2. The remaining shapes need the instruction's indexing or call fields.
+# Constant enum matches lower to a compact read-only lookup table.
+ir_operand_shape = (op: Op) -> int:
+    match op:
+        nop, block, loop, end, else_, br, trap, zeroslots, vzu: 0
+        iconst, fconst, slot, gaddr, daddr, faddr: 4
+        intr, call, syscall: 8
+        calli, callc: 9
+        if_, brif, brtable, assume, zero: 1
+        ret: 10
+        store: 11
+        vst: 12
+        copy: 2
+        memcpy, memset, vop: 3
+        select, memeq: 7
+        load: 13
+        mov, neg, not_, fneg, fsqrt, fabs, ffloor, fceil, ftrunc, sext8, sext16, sext32, zext8, zext16, zext32, i2f, u2f, f2i, f2f, bits2f, f2bits, vsplat: 5
+        _: 6
+
 # Sets the operand view; returns the defined vreg or -1. zeroslots definitions
 # are carried in ir.args and handled separately by the consumers.
 ir_operands = (ins: Ins) -> int:
-    ir_use_count = 0
     ir_use_span = -1
     a = int(ins.a)
     bb = int(ins.b)
@@ -339,58 +358,29 @@ ir_operands = (ins: Ins) -> int:
     ir_use_values.0 = a
     ir_use_values.1 = bb
     ir_use_values.2 = int(ins.c)
-    match ins.op:
-        nop, block, loop, end, else_, br, trap, zeroslots: return -1
-        iconst, fconst, slot, gaddr, daddr, faddr: return d
-        intr, call, syscall:
-            ir_use_span = a
-            ir_use_span_count = bb
-            ir_use_count = bb
-            return d
-        calli, callc:
+    shape = ir_operand_shape(ins.op)
+    if shape < 8:
+        ir_use_count = shape & 3
+        return if shape & 4 != 0: d else: -1
+    match shape:
+        8, 9:
             ir_use_span = a
             ir_use_span_count = bb
-            ir_use_count = bb + 1
+            ir_use_count = bb + (if shape == 9: 1 else: 0)
             return d
-        if_, brif, brtable, assume:
-            ir_use_count = 1
+        10:
+            ir_use_count = if a >= 0: 1 else: 0
             return -1
-        ret:
-            if a >= 0: ir_use_count = 1
-            return -1
-        store:
+        11:
             ir_use_count = 2
             if int(ins.c) & M_INDEX != 0:
                 ir_use_values.2 = d
                 ir_use_count = 3
             return -1
-        vst:
+        12:
             ir_use_values.2 = d
             ir_use_count = 3
             return -1
-        vsplat:
-            ir_use_count = 1
-            return d
-        vzu: return -1
-        copy:
-            ir_use_count = 2
-            return -1
-        zero:
-            ir_use_count = 1
-            return -1
-        memcpy, memset, vop:
-            ir_use_count = 3
-            return -1
-        select, memeq:
-            ir_use_count = 3
-            return d
-        load:
-            ir_use_count = 1
-            if int(ins.c) & M_INDEX != 0: ir_use_count = 2
-            return d
-        mov, neg, not_, fneg, fsqrt, fabs, ffloor, fceil, ftrunc, sext8, sext16, sext32, zext8, zext16, zext32, i2f, u2f, f2i, f2f, bits2f, f2bits:
-            ir_use_count = 1
-            return d
         _:
-            ir_use_count = 2
+            ir_use_count = if int(ins.c) & M_INDEX != 0: 2 else: 1
             return d

compilation.sample_order: Alternating for two variants; rotating positions and direction for three or more.
compilation.cpu_time_definition: User + system CPU seconds for the compiler and its waited-for children; may exceed wall time with multiple emission workers.

independent_operand_probe.generator:
from pathlib import Path
import re
root=Path.cwd();b=root/'__dewycache__/task-tmp/sloppy-comparison';s=(root/'core/compiler/ir.jo').read_text()
enum=s[s.index('enum Op:')+len('enum Op:'):s.index('const VI')]
names=re.findall(r'\b\w+\b','\n'.join(line.split('#')[0] for line in enum.splitlines()))
no_use=set('nop block loop end else_ br trap zeroslots vzu iconst fconst slot gaddr daddr faddr'.split())
one_use=set('mov neg not_ fneg fsqrt fabs ffloor fceil ftrunc sext8 sext16 sext32 zext8 zext16 zext32 i2f u2f f2i f2f bits2f f2bits vsplat if_ brif brtable assume zero'.split())
two_use=set('add sub mul divs divu rems remu and_ or_ xor shl shrs shru eq ne lts les gts ges ltu leu gtu geu fadd fsub fmul fdiv fmin fmax feq fne flt fle fgt fge copy vld vbin mulhs mulhu streq'.split())
three_use=set('memcpy memset vop select memeq'.split())
special=set('intr call syscall calli callc ret store vst load'.split())
no_def=set('nop block loop end else_ br trap zeroslots vzu if_ brif brtable assume ret store vst copy zero memcpy memset vop'.split())
assert set(names)==no_use|one_use|two_use|three_use|special,(set(names)-(no_use|one_use|two_use|three_use|special))
head=s[s.index('enum Op:'):s.index('# current function being built')]+'\nir: IrFn\n'+s[s.index('ir_use_count ='):]
body=['main = () -> int:', '    ir.args = [101, 102, 103, 104]']
for name in names:
 for mode in [0,128]:
  for no_value in [False,True]:
   a=11;b0=12;c=13+mode;d=17
   if name in ('intr','call','syscall','calli','callc'):a=1;b0=2
   if name=='ret' and no_value:a=-1
   used=[]
   if name in one_use:used=[a]
   elif name in two_use:used=[a,b0]
   elif name in three_use:used=[a,b0,c]
   elif name in ('intr','call','syscall'):used=[102,103]
   elif name in ('calli','callc'):used=[102,103,c]
   elif name=='ret':used=[] if a<0 else [a]
   elif name=='store':used=[a,b0]+([d] if mode else [])
   elif name=='vst':used=[a,b0,d]
   elif name=='load':used=[a]+([b0] if mode else [])
   out=-1 if name in no_def else d
   body += [f'    assert(ir_operands(Ins(.{name}, 0, {d}, {a}, {b0}, {c}, 0)) == {out})',f'    assert(ir_use_count == {len(used)})']
   body += [f'    assert(ir_use({i}) == {v})' for i,v in enumerate(used)]
body+=['    42']
(b/'operand-probe.jo').write_text(head+'\n'+'\n'.join(body)+'\n')
print(len(names),'ops,',len(names)*4,'cases')

decision: Default/release compile ratios 1.0014/0.9986 are essentially flat; fixed compiler self-build is 1.0045.
Instructions increase about 0.06%/0.12% for large default/release builds; self-build is effectively unchanged. No useful gain to justify the descriptor representation.
Preserve the exact patch and pilot; do not promote the compiler or ratchet either performance reference.
